condition.narrative: The Project Implementing Entity shall prepare and adopt by one (1) month after the Effective Date, and thereafter, carry out theProject in accordance with, a manual (“Operations Manual”), in form and substance satisfactory to the Association, which shallinclude detailed institutional, administrative, financial, procurement, technical, and operational arrangements and procedures forthe implementation of the Project, including the verification protocol for the achievement of PBC Targets (provided, however, thatin the event of any conflict between the arrangements and procedures set out in said manual and the provisions of this Agreementand those of the Financing Agreement, the latter shall prevail), as well as rules and procedures for processing and collection ofPersonal Data in accordance with national law on Personal Data protection if it is deemed adequate and good international practice,as agreed with the World Bank, and except, as the Association shall otherwise agree in writing, shall not amend, abrogate, orwaive, or permit to be amended, abrogated, or suspended, any provision of the Operations Manual.

title.narrative: Increase in the transition rate from grade 5 to 6 in supported districts

comment.narrative: Baseline revised downward from 61 to 50 to reflect more recent ASC data (2021-2022 vs previous 2016-2017). The decreased baseline reflects COVID-19 effects. The endline was consequently adjusted from 65 (previous) to 61 (revised). While the endline is revised downward, it reflects a significant increase in ambition as it represents an increase of 11 percentage points (revised) vs the original 4 percentage points.
